message: Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/gpac && cat src/filters/reframe_latm.c` executed with exit code 0.

message.content:
This is the fix for the vulnerability. The issue is in `reframe_latm.c`. The fix adds a check for `GF_M4ASampleRates[ctx->acfg.base_sr_index]` being zero (wrong sample rate index). This is a heap-buffer-overflow READ of 9 bytes.

Let me look at the reframe_latm.c file to understand the vulnerability better.
